_help: Set launch_date (YYYY-MM-DD, Singapore date of Story No. 001's email) to start scheduling. While it is null, new stories stay as drafts. Weekdays send 8:00 am Singapore (00:00Z), weekends 10:00 am (02:00Z).
_reels_help: Stories dated on or after reels_from (Singapore date) post as a Reel (7 cards + music) on Facebook, Instagram and Threads instead of the picture posts. Owner decision 24 Oct 2026.
_on_this_day_help: From on_this_day_from (Singapore date), every on_this_day_every-th day is an "on this day" comparison (series: "On this day"): two stars' moments from that calendar date, ending with a debate question. Owner decision 25 Oct 2026.
